title: VirSME People | HCM and Workforce Operations
description: Manage the employee lifecycle in a connected HCM environment linked to work, policies, permissions and business workflows.
hero: Run the employee lifecycle as one connected operating process.
intro: VirSME People is designed as a full HCM environment connected to communication, work, permissions, policies and wider business workflows.

blocks.text: Maintain the employee as one authorised business record instead of unrelated copies across HR, work, communication and approvals.
Coordinate onboarding, organisation structure, documents, policies, access, leave, approvals, performance, role changes, offboarding and other workforce processes through repeatable workflows.
VirSME AI can use authorised HR policies, onboarding procedures, approval rules and role structures to determine the next required step and request human authorization where necessary.

items: Stronger connection between HCM and operational work
More consistent application of policies and processes
Better continuity as the organisation grows
